inhomogeneous_deformation.description: First-order deformation under mixed fermion-boson relations
inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_convention: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y); each record gives a coefficient of its named gb parameter
inhomogeneous_deformation.parity_note: Coefficients are computed by the literal mixed-relation rule; the source definitions assign odd parity to both gb and kappa, whose product's parity convention is not resolved here.
